title: Turn the red GMCP mastery and hermetic-scope tests green on Linux
goal: On Linux x86_64 the root package's GMCP suite fails 16 tests and hermetic_scope fails 1. (1) The landing of 06e38eab0 removed 15 redundant allows under crates/susi-gmcp/src and reworded docs/gmcp/contract-203-020.md without re-recording the VC-203 evidence bound to those files, so every vector's records went stale and all 15 mastery tests plus gmcp_mastery_records_are_retained_and_current fail closed; re-record both phases with scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh. (2) gmcp_vc_203_014_mastery also closes its Unix-socket adapter without the initialize handshake (the pattern T-CLAUDECLOUDREL-3 and -5 fixed elsewhere); add the handshake. (3) hermetic_scope's nextest test names xtask as its bin-only package, but every workspace member has had a library since xtask gained one, so the test supplies its own metadata with a bin-only package instead.

reuse.searched: scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh and .agents/gmcp/evidence/README.md (the two-phase re-record), tests/gmcp_requirements/adapter_support.rs (adapter_handshake, already used at the fixed sites of T-CLAUDECLOUDREL-3 and -5 and in this file's own operations test), scripts/check-hermetic-tests.sh and the World fixture in tests/hermetic_scope.rs (the fake cargo already answers metadata from a file).
reuse.reason: Every piece exists: the recorder script, the handshake helper and the fake cargo's metadata file. Nothing new is built.

results.gmcp: Both phases of scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh re-run on Linux x86_64: 90 requirement checks, then 15 mastery tests, all passed and recorded. cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test gmcp_requirements: every requirement, mastery and evidence-currency test passes; gmcp_vc_203_014_mastery passes on Linux for the first time (its socket adapter now handshakes before it closes).
results.hermetic_scope: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test hermetic_scope: 9 passed. The nextest test writes its own metadata with one library package and one binary-only package, since no workspace member is bin-only any more.
results.host_only_privacy: Environmental, not a product fault. Both tests need a routed address local_only keeps local (private or link-local). This cloud container's only routed address is 192.0.2.2, a documentation range the policy rightly treats as an internet host, so 'local_only reaches the LAN listener' cannot hold there. The tests now fail at once naming that precondition (0.13 s) instead of timing out after 24 s. Proof: in a private network namespace given 10.99.0.2 on loopback and a default route through it, both tests pass unchanged (2 passed).
results.ceiling: CEO decision 2026-11-15 ('raise any test run limit so harness continues to run'): TEST_RUST_CEILING 127,000 -> 129,000, recorded in docs/lean-core.md.
results.cause: The stale evidence was this agent's own regression: 06e38eab0 changed crates/susi-gmcp/src and docs/gmcp without re-recording, and the verification before that landing ran only part of the GMCP suite.
results.coordination: tests/host_only_privacy.rs is named in T-CODEXHOSTONLYSERIAL-1 (worker codex-host-only-serial); that work is on main with its results recorded and no live claim, and this change only adds a precondition assertion. Board and claim pushes are refused from this cloud session (HTTP 403), so this record and the commit trailers carry the coordination.
